## ⚡ 360 REV — EPISODE #10 BLUEPRINT
### How to Update Self-Hosted n8n on Hostinger VPS Safely in 60 Seconds

**🚀 1. Run This Workflow 24/7 (While Your Laptop is OFF):**
* [Launch Hostinger 1-Click n8n Cloud ($6.49/mo — Save $1,710/yr vs Zapier)](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep10&src=json_sticky&cta=canvas_card)
* *In hPanel, select **Applications → Ubuntu 24.04 with n8n** (Coupon `MMVPS` / Partner Deal auto-applied).*

**📊 2. Copy-Paste Google Sheets Columns (Row 1 Headers):**
`Backup_Date | Backup_File_Name | Workflows_Backed_Up | Server_Version | Backup_Status`
* [Open Episode #10 Interactive Setup Hub & 1-Click Sheet Copy](https://360rev-hub.github.io/ep10/?src=json_sticky)

**🎥 3. Watch Video Setup Tutorial:**
* [Watch the 2-Minute Step-by-Step Video on YouTube (@360rev3)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GjVuxPdPsOg)

**🛠️ Architecture Highlights:**
* **Zone 1:** Runs every midnight (or right before you click Update in Hostinger hPanel) to export your workflows.
* **Zone 2:** Packages your n8n workflow definitions into a timestamped `.json` binary backup file.
* **Zone 3:** Uploads the `.json` backup to **Google Drive** and logs a verification row in **Google Sheets**.

---

## STEP 1: Midnight Auto-Backup Trigger
1. **1. Daily Midnight Backup Trigger** runs automatically at 00:00 every night (or click **Test workflow** right before updating your n8n version in Hostinger hPanel).

## STEP 2: Package Workflows into Timestamped .JSON File
1. **2. Build Timestamped .JSON Backup Bundle** exports your workflow metadata & generates a downloadable `.json` binary payload ready for Google Drive.

## STEP 3: Save to Google Drive & Log to Google Sheets
1. **3. Upload Backup .JSON to Google Drive** saves the backup file in your Drive folder.
2. **4. Log Backup Audit Row to Google Sheets** records the timestamp & status on your [Hostinger KVM 1 Cloud](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep10&src=json_step3)!
